journeys: Find a doctor: browse the list, filter by specialty chips, search by name.
Book: open a doctor, pick a day from the 7-day strip, pick an available time slot, enter patient name + 10-digit phone, see inline validation errors for invalid input, confirm.
Confirmation shows an appointment reference and the booked summary (doctor, day, time, fee).
My Appointments lists bookings (persisted across reload), each cancellable via an inline confirm; cancelling frees the slot.

rules.days: 7 days starting today, computed at runtime
rules.takenRule: slot is taken iff (doctorIndex + dayIndex + slotIndex) % 3 === 0, or it is already booked in a stored appointment
rules.validation: name must be >= 2 characters; errors render inline (error-name / error-phone) and booking does not proceed
